title.narrative: Enhancing Capacities and Preparedness of Montenegro’s Judiciary for EU Integration

description.narrative: Designed to contribute to the enhancement of the Rule of Law system by increasing independence, efficiency, and accountability of the judicial system and, notably, by facilitating the process of preparing necessary documentation, streamlining administrative procedures, and fostering the knowledge and skills of the Ministry of Justice. To foster a robust, independent, and effective judiciary system through comprehensive training programmes, exchange of best practices, and technical assistance, ultimately leading to increased alignment with EU norms and standards.
